<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant monoisotopic peak with a clear M+1 envelope (~12% of the base peak) and rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks, which is characteristic of the natural 13C isotopic distribution in organic molecules. No strong M+2 pattern indicative of Cl, Br, or S is present, so the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotopic pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
